about: Routes for the GPU run of our method without instructions (PLAN.md, 2026-11-18 07:29 UTC). Written before the run. routes[rule][task folder][i][str(t)] = 1-based position, in the task order, of the task that test example i (order of test.json) is given to after t tasks. ridge = rule L with ridge 1 (the chosen rule); joint = rule J with C = 1; claims = rule claims with r = 1; handicap = rule H' with t = 2 (the joint recogniser at every arrival, the newcomer may take at most 2 held-out inputs of each older task and nothing that the joint recogniser gives to an older task; added at 07:35 UTC, before the run); own = every input to its own task (perfect recognition, for comparison only). Feature: frozen T5-base encoder states of the instance text only; 200 fit and 200 held-out training inputs per task; test inputs are never used for fitting.
